brief: A hill above Ujjayinī at dawn: workmen's tents and ropes around a half-uncovered stone throne ringed by thirty-two weathered statues of women; the first statue, holding a lotus, close to the viewer; Lubdhaka's foreman frowning at her; you, Dādī and Śuka at the edge of the dig.
notes: Painting reviewed against its exact source brief. Every visible text string compared with the recorded source text; reference font inspected when needed. This is direct visual review, not an OCR-service result.
